description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from irishcentral.com, including methods for author, description, image, ingredients, instructions, title, yields, and keywords.

classes.name: IrishCentral
classes.description: A scraper class inheriting from AbstractScraper, tailored for irishcentral.com recipes.

methods.description: Extracts the author's name from the article header.
